title: Quaint Yeasty Peruvian Chicken Drumsticks Anticuchos
description: A high-protein Peruvian dish featuring yeasty cheese-pull chicken drumsticks, served in an anticuchos form, perfect for a cozy dinner.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine yeast, mozzarella cheese, aji amarillo pepper paste, garlic, olive oil, salt, black pepper, and paprika.
Add the chicken drumsticks to the bowl and toss to coat evenly with the yeast and cheese mixture.
Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil and spray with cooking spray, then arrange the chicken drumsticks on the baking sheet.
Bake the chicken drumsticks in the preheated oven for 25 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the oven and let it rest for 5 minutes.
Serve the chicken drumsticks hot, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro if desired.
Traditionally, anticuchos are grilled, so if desired, grill the chicken drumsticks over medium-high heat for 5-7 minutes per side instead of baking.
